acceptance_checks: Every file in .shiki/tasks/ has a cca_checklist_profile key.
No task file's profile contains a bare family name; the 8 previously prefix-shaped files are [], including the LIVE one.
Driving checklist_profile_coverage_failures with each task's real profile against an all-pass verdict yields zero blocking reasons for every task.
No frozen governance field (scope, non_goals, required_skills, risk_level, locks, acceptance_checks, test_command) differs from its pre-change value in any task file.
No status, expected_pr, closeout_pr, expected_branch or ledger_evidence value differs from its pre-change value in any task file.
The diff equals the migration's re-run output exactly; no file was hand-edited.
The PR body carries the marker and exactly one Migration: line.
No file outside the declared locks is changed.
non_goals: Hand-editing any file in the diff
Touching any file outside the declared locks
scope:
Run the registered backfill migration against this repository's mirror and deliver the result as a migration-mode PR: the body carries the `<!-- shiki:migration -->` marker and a single `Migration: <id>` line, and the diff is exactly the migration's output — every task file that gains `cca_checklist_profile`, the 8 whose prefix-shaped value becomes `[]`, and the `.shiki/migrations/state.json` record. No file outside `.shiki/` and no hand edit of any kind: if the diff needs adjusting, the migration is what changes, in its own PR, and this one is re-run.

The maintainer applies `mergegate:migration`; nothing in this task applies it.

REPRODUCIBILITY — what this task removes, and what to change to get the same result.
  Symptom: the field is still absent from most of the mirror, one live task remains unmergeable, and the promotion cannot proceed.
  Measured 2026-08-01: 112 task files; 104 lack `cca_checklist_profile`; 8 carry `['PR','TDD','V','CCA']`, of which T-20260613T095433721787Z-8d6b04d5 is LIVE at status=review.
  Exact change that reproduces this result: run the migration, commit only its output, declare it in the body.
  Why no hand edits: the gate proves the diff equals the migration's re-run output. A single hand-touched byte blocks with the path named — by design, and it is the property that makes reviewing one function sufficient.
  Reproducible when: a fully passing verdict yields zero profile-coverage blocking reasons for every task in the repository.
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target .
title: Apply the backfill through migration mode
